answer: The tide holds work receipts rather than names, so the wander of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, idle agents bleed standing. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the falcon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
